name: cyber
description: > This README is written so a beginner developer can **rebuild a working clone from scratch** by following it. It documents the **actual code in `backend/` + `client/`**, not an ideal. Where code cuts corners for hackathon speed, it says so.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix Client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix Client && npm run build --prefix Client
